title: Noise on affine one-bit functions
statement: For $\rho,a\in\mathbb{R}$, define $f:\{0,1\}\to\mathbb{R}$ by $f(x)=1+a\sigma(x)$, where $\sigma(0)=1$ and $\sigma(1)=-1$. Then the Fourier noise operator satisfies $(T_\rho f)(x)=1+\rho a\sigma(x)$ for every $x\in\{0,1\}$.
replaced: For $\rho,a\in\bbr$, let $f(b)=1+a(-1)^b$ on $\{0,1\}$. Then $T_\rho f(b)=1+\rho a(-1)^b$ for both bits $b$. For $d\in\mathbb N$, $h:\{0,1\}^d\to\bbr$, and $\tau\in\bbr$, the spectral noise operator is $T_\tau h(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[d]}\tau^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\E[h\chi_S]$ under the uniform measure.
